mostWorthwhile.text: Adding the venous valves was most worthwhile: the muscle compression and arrows gave a clear picture of how they help blood return toward the heart.

leastWorthwhile.text: Making the thin-walled veins felt least informative on its own; the picture showed their shape but did not explain much about it.

surprise.text: The connection between contracting limb muscles and venous return added a useful detail I had not expected from the valve choice alone.

arbitrary.text: No action felt purposeless, although several were the only offered combination and involved little decision-making.

continue.text: I would continue for another chapter to see how the vessel network connects with the rest of the body, though I would hope for more meaningful choices.
